title: 040 screens (research R9, R10): the selected model's p_buy as a width-book sizer; the five auxiliary heads' skill over causal trailing baselines and their ranking of width-book trades; the arms that follow passing screens
label: PROVISIONAL. Committed before the selected model's signal tables and the heads-trained model exist. Screens can only ELIMINATE (constitution III); a pass earns a P&L arm, nothing more.

relevance_rule.population: the 412 early width-book trades (research.new_inputs.trades.trades(); refuses unless count and the 0.1004 control-at-share gap reproduce)
relevance_rule.pass: gap_share50 >= 0.05 AND partial Spearman (given bb_width) > 0 AND that sign in >= 5 of 8 folds, in the ONE pre-declared direction; early half only (late stays blind)

sizer.score: p_buy of the selected model <M> (signal tables <M>_fNN)
sizer.arm_spec: WidthSizerMixin, WidthBookMixin over <M>, AGREE_RULE p_buy, per-fold 0.5-agree-share threshold (research.control_sizer.pick); width cuts = w_aro's; exits = w_aro's framework copied by framework_sha; its unsized twin {M}_wb must equal w_aro on 15/15 folds (identity) before the sizer is read

heads_model.side_check: its trading head (judge_one({M}_ah, {M})) is reported, not a verdict

regime.use: entry gate on cs_aro's width book: skip entries whose BEAR probability >= that fold's tail 80th percentile

risk.use: stake sizer on w_aro (cs pattern): low risk -> 1.333x, else 0.667x, 0.5-share threshold on P(HIGH) from the tail

momentum.use: stake sizer on w_aro (cs pattern) on P(up), 0.5-share threshold from the tail

flow.use: stake sizer on w_aro (cs pattern) on P(up), 0.5-share threshold from the tail

profit.use: bail-out exit on cs_aro: close at the first candle >= 2 bars after entry with P(LOSS) >= the tail 90th percentile

skill_rule.auc: one-vs-rest AUC of the head's class_index probability against the head's own training label (NNMT's target methods), on tradeable test bars, pooled per half
skill_rule.pass: margin = AUC(head) - AUC(causal baseline) >= 0.02 in BOTH halves

baseline_windows.note: trailing analogues of each label's centred window (regime: close / trailing 200-bar mean - 1; risk / flow / momentum: trailing mean of atr_norm / di_diff_scaled / aroonosc_scaled; profit: trailing 8-bar return)

head_pass: skill_pass AND relevance pass -> the head's arm runs; otherwise recorded with no arm
tails: head-arm percentiles come from out-of-sample tail tables: each fold's TRAIN_DATA_SPLIT holdout (the last 20% of each pair's training data, never fit), as 039's mix.py tables
seeds: any PASS is re-run on seed 2
seen_before: 039 sizer screens (NNPredict p: gap 0.028 fail; exc32 0.054 pass)
NNMT single-window studies: apply_task_filters on heads -14 pp; regime/profit heads untrained by default
